_doc: Emerald's Magma Emblem (emerald_ch45_magma 2026-10-12): the key item the old woman on Mt. Pyre's summit gives (scenes/MtPyre_Summit_Em.inc). Black 2's Magma Stone (item 458, a Gen 4 key item no Black 2 script gives; src/include/hoenn_version.inc ITEM_MAGMA_EMBLEM) renamed in an Emerald build only, in the format of src/text/overrides_key_items.json; the description is pokeemerald's sMagmaEmblemDesc. Sapphire and Ruby keep Black 2's names.

system/0063_scrcmd_resort_shop_scrcmd_bs.458: A medal-like item in\nthe same shape as\nTeam Magma’s mark.
